prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and company size. To help, tell me a bit about your needs (see questions below). Meanwhile, here’s a quick, practical approach and a few well-regarded agency types you’ll commonly find in SF.

Questions for me
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, demand/gen, leads, ecommerce sales, installs, SEO, content, web/app redesign)
- B2B or B2C?
- Monthly budget or annual marketing budget?
- Company stage and size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Do you need a full-service partner or a specialist (PPC, SEO, creative, growth)?

How to choose the “best” agency for you
- Define goals and KPIs first (CAC, LTV, MQLs, conversion rates).
- Look for vertical experience (SaaS, ecommerce, healthcare, etc.).
- Check case studies with measurable results and recent client references.
- Evaluate transparency: reporting cadence, dashboards, access to raw data.
- Team fit: dedicated team members vs rotating contractors.
- Pricing model and contract flexibility.
- Request a short trial or pilot campaign where possible.

Where to research agencies
- Clutch.co, G2, Agency Spotter, Google Reviews, LinkedIn, referrals from peers.

Example agency types (and common names you’ll see in SF)
- Performance marketing (PPC, paid social, growth): 3Q Digital is a well-known SF-based performance agency.
- Creative/brand and digital product: R/GA and AKQA operate in major markets including San Francisco and are often used by larger brands.
- Boutique growth/early-stage partners: numerous small SF boutiques specialize in startup growth — I can shortlist ones that match your vertical.

If you want, tell me your goals, budget and timeline and I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies (with pros/cons and questions to ask each).
